title: End membership ends in the app whatever the provider answers
assertion: Both End membership routes (the console's and an organization's Settings) end the membership and every session of the account and write `membership_ended` in one transaction with no call to the provider inside it; the provider is asked to sign the account out once, only after the commit is confirmed, and never when End membership is refused; a sign-out that fails undoes nothing, the answer is still that the membership ended, and it is one line at error (`security event: membership end provider sign-out failed`) with the user's ID, the request's ID and the error's name only (`NO_PROVIDER_SUBJECT` when the subject could not be read), never the subject, an address or the error's text, which `MembershipEndProviderSignOutFailed` alarms on at one in five minutes; the Settings route reads the subject while the membership stands, since row-level security hides the person's row once it has ended; nothing sends the sign-out again; and while the provider's sign-out has not happened a code step begun before End membership still opens a session, which carries no role, and a key-registration step begun before it still registers a key that then signs in: both are stated by tests as they stand and stay open until the membership's end moves the account's mark (`LANES.md` Queues item 37)
noFileReason: Synthetic personas have a membership ended through both routes with a provider twin whose sign-out fails, and steps begun before it are answered after; no file.
